# Target schema Ordinerad Medicinsk Onkologisk Behandling

Specific version of the target openEHR template the mapping is done towards:

<https://github.com/regionstockholm/CKM-mirror-via-modellbibliotek/blob/326bcc8b137c7e742420544122c424e4632a4b5a/local/OrdineradMedicinskOnkologiskBehandling_MedKurdag.t.json>

The Example Set `karda-ordinationsdata-to-openehr-flat` loads the above GitHub `.t.json` URL in a way so that dependent archetypes are fetched from the same branch. Do not load the `.t.json` as a single file.
